title: Noor and the Safehouse Again
author: Silas Sterling
blurb: Elodie Ashgrove, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
